sections.Profile:
Firecracker , released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in February 1971, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Harry Williams with artwork by Christian Marche.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1971
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Party, Fireworks, Dancing, Original Theme, Festival, 1970s, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Christian Marche
- Design: Harry Williams
